verdict.rationale: The Pylon MCP server authenticates AI tools via OAuth and limits them to reading and updating issues, accounts, and contacts within the data the authorizing user can already see. That gives agents bounded, user-inherited access rather than purpose-built least-privilege credentials. The API is documented, but nothing describes scoped or permissioned API keys for agents. Missing for 10: dedicated agent/service credentials, configurable permission scopes on API keys or OAuth grants, read-only or per-resource restrictions, credential rotation/revocation docs, independent corroboration.
